model: logistic regression (stress detection; WESAD lab stressor, NOT panic/anxiety)
score: x_i <- imputer_medians[i] if x_i is NaN; z = bias_folded + sum_i weights_folded[i] * x_i; p = 1 / (1 + exp(-z)); window alert if p >= threshold (equivalently z >= logit_threshold)

smoothing.rule: alert at window t if >= m of the OP1 window decisions at t, t-5 s, ..., t-5(n-1) s are positive (causal; windows not yet available count as negative)

what_the_wearer_does: Put the device on (GSR electrodes, PPG sensor) and keep it on for the whole session.

Let the filters run before calibrating: in WESAD the causal filters had run for 26-643 s before the calibration period began; at least 60 s (> 5 x the 8 s EMA tau) is RECOMMENDED but this warm-up rule is untested.

Sit still and at rest for 5 minutes: seated, relaxed, hand still, no talking, no walking, no eating/drinking, comfortable room (WESAD baseline: seated, reading neutral magazines; the calibration period is its first 5 min).
Do not start calibration during or straight after exercise or a stressful event.

statistics_computed.sigma_lp_cal: population SD (ddof 0) of the causally low-passed EDA samples (1 Hz Butterworth order 2 at 4 Hz, SOS state carried from power-on) over the 5-min calibration period (1200 samples at 4 Hz). Device units (mV) are fine: only ratios are used.
statistics_computed.sigma_ph_cal: population SD (ddof 0) of the phasic EDA (low-passed EDA minus causal EMA tonic, tau 8 s) over the same 1200 samples.

used_by.eda_slope_rel: least-squares slope (per s) of the low-passed EDA over the window / sigma_lp_cal
used_by.scr_count_rel: number of scipy.signal.find_peaks(phasic window, prominence >= 1.0 x sigma_ph_cal, distance >= 4 samples = 1 s) in the window

calibration.validity_rule_UNTESTED: repeat calibration if either sigma is 0 or not finite; there is no validated lower bound on the prototype

wesad_reference_values_uS.note: E4 wrist EDA in uS; NOT comparable to finger mV on the prototype

calibration.pipeline_note: In WESAD the calibration period is the first 5 min of the baseline condition; the same stream is used afterwards, so the filters are NOT restarted between calibration and use.

expected_performance: the LOSO result of config D (results/metrics/final_results.csv); this fitted model has no held-out estimate
